definitions.name: F1C.NEXT
definitions.body: 'I' BIND 'X' BIND 1 X 2 DIV X 3 MUL 1 ADD X 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT X 1 EQ SELECT

definitions.name: F1C.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: word -> the word in lower case with its first letter in upper case

definitions.name: F1C.SPJOIN
definitions.note: Vector of texts -> one text with the texts joined by single spaces

definitions.name: F1C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle numbers when the count is even)

definitions.name: F1C.ARGKEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R VALUES [ -1 MUL ] MAP ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND R KEYS I GET
definitions.note: Record -> the key whose value is largest, the first such key on ties

definitions.name: F1C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: ledger Vector of [name amount] -> Record from each name to the sum of its amounts

definitions.name: F1C.REV
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER 'P' BIND P [ 'qty' GET ] MAP P [ 'price' GET ] MAP MUL G0A.SUM
definitions.note: orders Vector -> total of qty times price over the orders that have a price

definitions.name: F1C.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders Vector -> Record from each sku to the sum of its qty, in first-appearance order
